faq.question: What's the difference between RAG and fine-tuning, and which do we need?
faq.answer: For most enterprise use-cases where you need answers grounded in your own documents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is the right starting point: it keeps your data outside the model and stays cheap to update. Fine-tuning only pays off when you need a specific tone or format at scale. We help you choose based on your data and budget, not hype.

faq.question: How do you stop an LLM from hallucinating on our data?
faq.answer: We ground responses in your content using retrieval pipelines and citations, so the model answers from real sources instead of guessing. It's the same principle behind the hybrid search system we built for SURF's Orchestrator-Core.

faq.question: Do you build on hosted models like OpenAI and Anthropic, or self-hosted ones?
faq.answer: Both. We integrate the leading hosted models when they're the best fit, and deploy self-hosted, open models when data sovereignty or cost matters. It's the same approach behind our OpenClaw work.

faq.question: Can you add AI to our existing application without a rebuild?
faq.answer: Yes. We embed AI into your current stack through APIs and targeted automation, rather than starting from scratch.

faq.question: What makes an AI system production-ready rather than a demo?
faq.answer: Proper evaluation, monitoring, and iteration, plus cost control and security. We focus on systems that keep working after launch, not one-off prototypes.

sdn.title: Software Defined Networking
sdn.description: Automate and orchestrate your network infrastructure with battle-tested open-source tooling.
sdn.metaDesc: Network automation and orchestration with the Workflow Orchestrator (WFO), proven in enterprise environments.

faq.question: What is the Workflow Orchestrator (WFO)?
faq.answer: The Workflow Orchestrator (WFO) is an open-source platform for automating and orchestrating networks. It provides workflow and product modeling, standardised forms, and integrations with tools like Netbox and Ansible, giving you full control over your network lifecycle.

faq.question: How does the WFO compare to general workflow engines like Temporal or Airflow?
faq.answer: Temporal and Airflow are general-purpose workflow engines; the Workflow Orchestrator is purpose-built for network and service orchestration, with product and subscription modeling and standardised forms built in. That domain focus means far less custom scaffolding to model your network products as code.

faq.question: Is the Workflow Orchestrator production-ready, and who uses it?
faq.answer: Yes, it's an established open-source project used by large research and service-provider networks. Virge has delivered multiple WFO integration projects for large corporates and service providers, and contributed the hybrid search shipped in orchestrator-core.

faq.question: Can you integrate the WFO with our existing network stack?
faq.answer: Yes. We connect it to Netbox for IPAM/DCIM, Ansible for device configuration via LSO, and your internal systems through custom APIs.

sdn.wfoDesc: The Workflow Orchestrator is an open-source platform for automating and orchestrating networks. It provides workflow and product modeling, standardised forms, and integrations with tools like Netbox and Ansible, giving you full control over your network lifecycle.
sdn.enterpriseDesc: We've delivered multiple WFO integration projects for large corporates and service providers. From initial architecture to production rollout, we know how to embed the Workflow Orchestrator into complex, existing environments.
sdn.modelingDesc: Define your network products and services as code. We help you model subscriptions, product types, and automated workflows that map directly to your business processes, reducing manual work and eliminating errors.
sdn.integrationsDesc: Connect the Workflow Orchestrator to your existing stack. Netbox for IPAM/DCIM, Ansible for device configuration via LSO, and custom APIs for your internal systems. We build the glue that makes it all work together.
sdn.iacDesc: Treat your network like software. Version-controlled configurations, repeatable deployments, and automated provisioning, bringing DevOps practices to network engineering.
sdn.trainingDesc: Get your team up to speed. We offer hands-on workshops covering WFO architecture, workflow development, and best practices for network automation at scale.
sdn.originTitle: Started at SURF, built by a community
originText: The Workflow Orchestrator was started by SURF, the Dutch research and education network, to automate its own network. SURF released it as open source, and ESnet soon joined as a major contributor.

Today it is an independent programme under The Commons Conservancy, used and developed by networks around the world such as ESnet, GÉANT, Internet2, CANARIE, GARR and REANNZ. Virge is part of that community: we contributed the AI search in orchestrator-core and build on the WFO for our clients.
sdn.archIntro: You write a Python application on top of orchestrator-core. It holds your products, workflows and forms; the core gives you the API, the UI, state and an audit log. The steps in your workflows talk to the systems that touch the network.

faq.question: What is ShopVirge?
faq.answer: ShopVirge is our webshop system for spinning up fully functional online stores fast, ideal for new brands, pop-up shops, or rapid market testing without months of development. Learn more at ShopVirge.com.

faq.question: Can you enrich product content automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, our Content as a Service turns a product name into rich descriptions, images, and metadata, automating hours of manual work.

faq.question: Which eCommerce platform should we build on?
faq.answer: That depends on your catalog, scale, and integrations. We give strategic, vendor-neutral advice on platform selection, architecture, and payments.

originText: ShopVirge is the webshop platform we build and run ourselves. You describe your products once; ShopVirge translates them, publishes them in every language you choose and handles checkout through Stripe.

openclaw.title: OpenClaw Consultancy
openclaw.description: Your own AI assistant that actually knows your business. We help you set it up, keep it running, and make it work for you.
openclaw.metaDesc: Run your own AI assistant. We help you deploy, host, secure, and automate with OpenClaw.

faq.question: What is OpenClaw?
faq.answer: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant framework that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to your messaging platforms, tools, and data, giving you a personal AI that understands your business context.

faq.question: Why self-host an AI assistant instead of using a SaaS tool?
faq.answer: Your data stays on your own hardware, a VPS or even a Mac Mini, which matters for privacy, compliance, and predictable cost. You're not sending sensitive business data to a third-party service.

faq.question: How do you keep a self-hosted assistant secure?
faq.answer: We harden the full stack: firewall configuration, access controls, and encrypted communications, so an assistant handling sensitive data stays locked down.

faq.question: Can you run and maintain it for us?
faq.answer: Yes. If you'd rather not manage infrastructure, we offer managed hosting: kept up, updated, and monitored, with zero hassle on your end.

faq.question: What can OpenClaw actually automate?
faq.answer: We connect it to your email, calendar, CRM, messaging, and databases, then build workflows that save hours every week.

openclaw.deployDesc: Run OpenClaw on a VPS or Mac Mini. Your data stays yours. We handle the full setup: installation, configuration, networking, and making sure everything talks to each other.
openclaw.hostingDesc: Don't want to manage infrastructure? We'll host your OpenClaw instance for you. Always up, always updated, zero hassle on your end.
openclaw.securityDesc: AI assistants handle sensitive data, so we make sure yours is locked down. From firewall configuration to access controls and encrypted communications, we cover the full security stack.
openclaw.automationDesc: The real power of OpenClaw is automation. We help you connect it to your tools (email, calendar, CRM, messaging, databases) and build workflows that save hours every week.
openclaw.whatIsDesc: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant framework that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to your messaging platforms, tools, and data, giving you a personal AI that understands your business context. Think of it as your always-on team member that never forgets, never sleeps, and gets smarter over time.

privacy.title: We do not track you.
privacy.description: Deliberately. No analytics, no cookies, no tracking pixels, no third-party scripts. The only data we have is what you choose to send us.
privacy.metaDesc: Virge deliberately does not track you: no analytics, no cookies, no tracking pixels. We only have what you choose to share with us.

promises.title: No cookies
promises.text: No cookie banner, because there is nothing to consent to.

promises.title: No analytics
promises.text: No Google Analytics or any other statistics tool. Not even a visitor counter.

promises.title: No tracking
promises.text: No tracking pixels, fingerprinting, ad networks or social media widgets.

promises.title: No third-party scripts
promises.text: Everything on this site comes from our own domain. Nothing phones home.

promises.title: Never sold
promises.text: What you share with us stays with us. We never sell or rent it.

sections.title: Why we don't track
body: We build software for a living, and we know how much a typical website quietly collects. We don't think you should pay for reading a blog post with your data. So we made a choice: Virge works without knowing who you are. If you want to talk, you tell us. That is the only way we learn anything about you.

sections.title: What you share with us
body: We only receive what you type in and send yourself:

• Contact form: your name, email address and message.
  • Webinar registration: your name, email address, the webinar you choose and, if you fill them in, your company and a question in advance.
  • Job applications: whatever you email us, such as your CV.
We use it only for the reason you sent it: to answer you, to send you the join link for your webinar or to handle your application. No newsletter unless you ask for one.

sections.title: Who helps us
body: Formspree delivers form submissions to our inbox. It processes them on our behalf and only to deliver them to us. See the Formspree privacy policy.

GitHub Pages hosts this website. Like any web server, it briefly records technical data such as your IP address to deliver pages and keep the service secure. We don't get access to these logs and don't use them. See the GitHub privacy statement.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: No longer than needed. Messages and applications are deleted when the conversation is finished, unless it turns into a collaboration.

sections.title: Your rights
body: The GDPR gives you the right to ask us at any time what we have about you, and to have it corrected or deleted. Send a message via our contact page and we will respond within a month. Not happy with how we handle it? You can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

sections.title: Changes
body: If we ever change how we handle your data, we update this page first. If we were ever to add analytics or cookies, we would say so here, and ask for your consent where the law requires it.

privacy.formNotice: We only use your details for this registration. No tracking, ever. See our privacy policy.
privacy.contactNotice: We only use your details to reply to you. No tracking, ever. See our privacy policy.
